events.name: Vida Amore Divas Show: Fiesta Semaforo
events.description:
Red. Yellow. Green. You choose, you announce. Fiesta Semáforo returns for its 25th anniversary — the longest-running drag show in Washington — and this time it's extra loaded: we're throwing a birthday shout-out for the one and only Vida Amore. Wear your color at the door: red if you've already found your love (or you love yourself and that's plenty), yellow if you're still deciding on that situationship, green if you came to flirt, kiss, and let the night run wild.

Vida Amore takes the stage with her full cast — Alyana Amore co-hosting with all her spark, Victoria Amore pouring on the sensuality, and Labebota Amore lighting up the floor with zero brakes. DJ ShaReal keeps the beats moving all night long. Watch the cast's colors too — if someone's flashing yellow or green, you already know what to do.

Raise a glass to Vida with her special birthday drink, made just for the occasion. Step out to our newly renovated patio, cup in hand, under the July sky. Doors open at 8:30, show starts at 9:30 — and tables go fast. Book yours now, because you will not find a seat improvising at the door.

This is not a night you watch from the corner. This is a night you wear, head to toe, in full color.

events.name: White Gurls Banger Drag Show
events.description:
Party like a rockstar, mija — DJ Dea, aka Sir Knight Haven Rexia, is turning 21 and Azúcar is throwing the birthday bash to match. Think every white-girl-banger anthem you screamed into a hairbrush from 2000 to 2010-something, remixed into a full drag house party on the Main Floor.

This isn't a polite sit-down show — it's girly pop chaos with heels on. Expect lip syncs to your most shameless guilty pleasures, birthday-girl theatrics, confetti energy, and a lineup of queens ready to turn "basic" into an art form. Dea's hosting her own coronation, so come ready to scream the words and hype her up like it's your bestie's big one-night-only quinceañera.

The room's giving glitter, sequins, and zero chill — house party rules apply: dance on everything (figuratively), sing off-key, buy the birthday girl a shot. Cocktails are flowing, the energy's unhinged in the best way, and every body's welcome to lose it to bangers that never should've slapped this hard.

July 19th, 8PM, Main Floor — come toast Sir Knight Haven Rexia into her 21st era. She's officially legal and she's coming for the whole night.

events.name: Alice in Bass Land
events.description:
Forget the tea party — this rabbit hole drops straight into bass. Cabana Bass Productions takes over Main Floor on July 24th at 10PM and bends the room into something curiouser and curiouser: a warped, glitched-out wonderland where techno beats and heavy bass replace the Mad Hatter's riddles. Azúcar becomes the looking glass, and once you step through, there's no walking back out the same.

Expect a set that shifts like Wonderland itself — one minute hypnotic and creeping, the next full teeth-bared drop, Cabana Bass Productions steering the whole night like a Cheshire grin you can't quite trust. Lighting twists the room into something unreal, the crowd moves like they fell down their own rabbit hole, and every corner of Azúcar leans into the madness — sensorial, strange, electric.

This isn't a themed night. It's Alice in Wonderland if Wonderland ran on 140 BPM and never blinked. Come lose your logic, keep your rhythm — Main Floor turns into the maddest tea party this side of any looking glass.

events.name: Noche Latina
events.description:
Cynthia Marche is back, and she's bringing the heat. This queen has been keeping Latinx nightlife alive for years, and her show is the kind of spectacle that leaves you breathless—equal parts glamour, humor, and unabashed sensuality. She'll warm you up with a performance that'll make your abuela clutch her pearls (in the best way), then our DJ takes over and keeps the energy climbing all night.

Noche Latina is our monthly love letter to Latinx culture, and it lives in the Ranchero Room—packed, pulsing, unapologetic. The music is pure Latino heat: reggaeton, salsa, bachata, cumbia, whatever makes your hips move. The vibe is provocative without pretense. The crowd is here to feel alive, to laugh, to move, to belong.

Come early, stay late, bring your crew. Cynthia's got jokes and pipes for days. The DJ's got the soundtrack to your night. We've got the drinks and the space where you can be exactly as spicy as you want to be.

events.name: Night of Kings

events.name: Heels Dance Class with Frankie
events.description:
Heels on, walls down — Frankie's teaching you how to move like you own the room. This is a step-by-step class built for beginners and anyone ready to level up, no experience necessary and every body welcome to strut in.

We start with the fundamentals: posture, balance, the technique that makes heelwork look effortless even when it isn't. Then comes the stretch — crucial, don't skip it — loosening you up so your hips, spine, and confidence all move together. By the end of the hour you'll have a fully choreographed routine down, sharp enough to show off and fun enough to want to do it again.

Frankie brings the energy of a big sister who won't let you quit and won't let you fall — patient, hype, and a little bit fierce. Expect sweat, laughter, a few wobbles, and a room full of people cheering each other on instead of comparing.

Main Floor, Thursday July 30 at 6pm. Come stretch, come sweat, come strut — Azúcar's floor is yours for the taking.

events.name: Seven Deadly sins

This isn't your average drag show, mi gente. This is spooky, seductive, and unapologetically extra.

Expect smoke, shadow, skin, and sequins. Each sin gets its own performer, its own energy, its own moment to make you gasp, laugh, or fan yourself. Rohla Blunt commands the night with wicked charm and zero mercy — part ringmaster, part temptress, all icon. The room pulses with dark glamour: think candlelight meets confetti, sin meets celebration.

Specials on hand to match the mood — because indulgence is the whole point tonight. Come dressed as your favorite vice, or just come ready to worship at the altar of drag. Every sin welcome. Every body ready to sin a little.
